step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows the application delivery platform 'Lagoon' built by Amazie.io on AWS. On the left side, developers push code to Git (ThirdParty), triggering Webhooks into the Lagoon management plane running on an EKS cluster. On the right side, Lagoon orchestrates target EKS clusters that run base workloads on standard EC2 instances and dev/non-prod workloads on EC2 Spot instances. Connected to the compute nodes are storage services: Aurora R6g for relational databases, EBS GP3 for block storage, and EFS for file assets.
